sections.title: Summary
sections.text: Full-stack software engineer with two software engineering internships and a track record of independently building and operating production systems end to end, spanning backend, frontend, and infrastructure. Comfortable across Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, and Docker, with experience exposing APIs and MCP interfaces for AI-agent access. Founded and led a 5-member CS Club executive team, writing the Python curriculum and running hands-on workshops.

entries.title: Software Engineering Intern
bullets: Designed an Intercom-integrated issue writer auto-drafting bug reports from support conversations, adopted for 97.5% of customer tickets.
Built lumadot, an autonomous AI code-review agent integrated with GitHub Actions across ~11 org repos; the org's most-used agent, reviewing 87% of merged PRs.
Built an issue analyst linking the agent read-only to six external systems (Rollbar, Datadog, GCP, Intercom, MySQL, Cloudflare) for cross-system triage; 79% approval rate on generated analyses.
Built luma-logger, a ~1,667-line Cloudflare Worker (TypeScript, Hono, Drizzle ORM, Cloudflare D1) exposing a read-only observability dashboard with run logs and per-run cost metrics.

entries.title: Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Engineered Python data pipelines with automated QC and improved ML/NLP workflows by migrating TF-IDF to FastText and designing LLM prompts for relabeling and corpus curation; boosted accuracy while cutting runtime.
Built analytics tooling and infrastructure: Streamlit UIs, Spark over Azure Blob, and Databricks/Colab GPUs; generated JSON-driven charts and presentation-ready insights.

entries.name: Planner - Multi-Tenant Calendar PWA
entries.stack: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, MCP
bullets: Built and operate a multi-tenant planner PWA unifying classes, work, and Canvas assignments on one calendar; 675 commits, ~45k lines of app code, ~1,364 tests.
Designed a three-layer domain model with recurrence materialized once per rule, and exposed a public REST API plus an OAuth-secured MCP server for agent access.

entries.name: Console - Self-Hosted PaaS Control Plane
entries.stack: Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, Docker, Traefik, MCP
bullets: Built and operate a self-hosted PaaS control plane running 6 production apps: zero-downtime deploys behind Traefik with health-checked swaps and rollback; 103 commits, 465 tests.
Implemented secretless CI-to-server auth via GitHub OIDC and exposed a dual REST/MCP interface (24 tools) for an AI agent to operate deploys and logs.

entries.name: CareerBase - Git-Style Resume Manager
entries.stack: Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, Claude Messages API
bullets: Built and deployed CareerBase, a git-style resume manager with full version history, diffing, and one-click PDF compilation, open to public sign-up; 240 commits, ~31k lines, ~274 tests.
Shipped an in-app AI agent on the Claude Messages API with a streaming tool loop and four least-privilege skills.

entries.title: President, CS Club
bullets: Led 5-member executive team at 16, organized planning meetings, and created Python curriculum.

entries.title: Software Captain, Robotics Team
bullets: Directed programming subteam and coordinated development tasks.

entries.school: New Jersey Institute of Technology, Ying Wu College of Computing

entries.coursework: Salutatorian; AP CSA, AP CSP, AP Calculus BC, AP Calculus AB, Honors Physics; STEM Scholars Program: shadowed at Merck (data analytics, Power BI, dimensional modeling) and Evergreen Financial Group (portfolio construction, trading, investment vehicles)
